patterns.note: Full-width sections with alternating background colors (dark blue, light grey, white) are used to clearly delineate distinct content blocks, with content centered and constrained within a maximum width.

The primary navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background as it becomes sticky. The hero section's background image/video exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content.

A dominant deep blue and a vibrant accent blue are consistently used for backgrounds, CTAs, and interactive elements, providing strong brand identity and visual hierarchy against clean white and light grey content areas.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles, supported by smaller, lighter subheadings and highly legible body text.
Feature sections frequently employ a grid layout, combining concise text blocks with illustrative icons or screenshots, presented against clean, often light-colored backgrounds.

technique_notes: The navigation bar dynamically changes its appearance and position upon scroll, transitioning from an initial transparent, full-height state to a sticky, condensed version with a solid background, likely using CSS transitions or keyframes.

The hero section utilizes a large background video or image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect, while foreground elements scroll normally.

Content sections are presented in a clean, stacked manner, with distinct background colors to visually separate them. Elements within sections appear to reveal naturally with the scroll, without overt entrance animations, relying on the page's natural flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, supported by smaller, lighter subheadings and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded (buttons, cards, input fields, and section corners like the blue CTA banner).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical padding between sections and within content blocks, creating an airy feel, especially in the hero.

standout: The site's standout feature is its ability to make complex music notation software feel accessible and modern, visually emphasized by the interactive sheet music hero and clear, benefit-driven feature explanations. The design effectively demystifies a specialized tool for a broad audience.
